## Who is Kavy Agrawal?

Kavy Agrawal is a freelance full-stack developer and SaaS architect based in Kanpur,
Uttar Pradesh, India. He builds scalable web applications, cross-platform mobile apps,
and SaaS platforms that serve real users. He is available for freelance and full-time
opportunities globally.

Contact: kavyagrawalrss@gmail.com
Portfolio: https://kavyagrawal.dev
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/kavy-agrawal-471739367/
GitHub: https://github.com/kavy4rss

## Technical Skills

- **Frontend**: React 18, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Three.js
- **Backend**: Node.js, Python, FastAPI, Express.js, GraphQL
- **Mobile**: Flutter, Dart
- **Databases**: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Firebase, Supabase
- **Cloud / DevOps**: AWS, Docker, Netlify, Vercel
- **Payments**: Stripe, Razorpay, PayU — custom gateway integration
- **AI / ML**: Gemini API, OpenAI API, LangChain, Chrome Extension Manifest V3
- **Tools**: Vite, Webpack, Git, Zod, React Hook Form, dnd-kit

## Projects

### Signal Scout
URL: https://kavyagrawal.dev/projects/signal-scout
Live: https://kavyagrawal.netlify.app/signal-scout/guide
GitHub: https://github.com/kavy4rss/Signal-Scout_Public
Category: AI / Chrome Extension

Signal Scout is a Chrome Extension that scores content credibility in real-time on
social media platforms (LinkedIn, X/Twitter). It uses on-device Gemini Nano AI for
zero-latency, privacy-first credibility scoring with cloud fallback to Gemini 1.5 Flash.
Built with Manifest V3, MutationObserver, and Webpack.

Problem solved: Social feeds are full of misinformation; Signal Scout attaches live
credibility badges without any data leaving the user's device.

Tech: Manifest V3, Gemini Nano, Gemini 1.5 Flash, Chrome Extension API, Webpack, MutationObserver

---

### Freelancer CRM
URL: https://kavyagrawal.dev/projects/freelancer-crm
Live: https://freelancer-crm-neon.vercel.app/
Category: SaaS

A comprehensive SaaS command center for freelancers. Features interactive drag-and-drop
Kanban boards (dnd-kit), real-time financial analytics (Recharts), automated invoice
generation with EmailJS reminders, and multi-tenant data model simulation with offline
caching.

Tech: React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI, Framer Motion, dnd-kit, Recharts, EmailJS

---

### Funnel Fix Pro
URL: https://kavyagrawal.dev/projects/funnelfixpro
Live: https://funnelfixpro.netlify.app/
Category: SaaS / AI

An interactive agency showcase platform demonstrating AI-driven lead qualification,
automated follow-up funnels, and revenue optimization for digital agencies. Features
a 3D BentoGrid layout and mock AI Lead Audit generator.

Tech: React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI, Framer Motion, React Query, Zod, Recharts

---

### Vyoamax Event Organiser
URL: https://kavyagrawal.dev/projects/vyoamax
Live: https://vyoamax.netlify.app/
Category: Web

A high-performance lead-generation portal for an event management company. Features
fluid Lenis scroll physics, 3D perspective contact cards, and client certificate
verification search.

Tech: Vite, React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI, Framer Motion, Lenis

---

### Craft Stock Manager
URL: https://kavyagrawal.dev/projects/craftstockmanager
Live: https://craftstockmanager.netlify.app/
Category: SaaS (Micro SaaS)

An offline-first Micro SaaS for crafters and small manufacturers to track raw materials
using FIFO logic, with automated expiration warnings and LocalStorage persistence.

Tech: React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI, Context API, React Query, Zod, Recharts

---

### Karma Navigator (Coming Soon)

Category: AI / Web

Tech: React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI, Framer Motion

### SafeGuard AI (Coming Soon)
URL: https://kavyagrawal.dev/projects/safeguard
Category: Mobile App / AI

A Flutter mobile security app that intercepts SMS phishing, scam calls, and digital
arrest fraud using Aho-Corasick string matching and Gemini 1.5 Flash AI analysis.

Tech: Flutter, Dart 3.2+, Riverpod, go_router, Gemini 1.5 Flash
